items.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: Ingrid was interviewed in Woodstock, New York, on August 11, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Ingrid was interviewed in Woodstock, New York, on August 11, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m in Woodstock, New York. I’m very pleased to be in the home of Ingrid Sertso and Karl Berger. Thank you for letting me come. And I read an interesting thing in your Columbia interview, and I thought I would try it at the front door but I didn’t, and that was to ask, “Oh are there any hippies still here?” I can just picture someone, a complete stranger, “Where’s the hippies?” But anyway, it’s a pleasure to meet you and I’ve heard your name for many years, and Karl’s name.
